title: Liar’s Poker
description: 1 captured save. One BASIC player with its printed spelling corrected; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: LIERS POKER
versions.note: validated payload. 24 consistent BASIC line pointers; normal end marker; byte-identical with left-hp800, left-hp1600; not execution-tested
versions.startupSource:
5 CLS:DC=20:DH=20
10 PRINT "LIER'S POKER"
15 I=INT((RND(0)[3)*10000+1):Q=RND(0):IFRND(2)=1THENQ=1/Q
17 R=0:QQ=RND(0)/Q*10000
20 PRINT:PRINT:PRINT
30 CN=RND(10000):HN=RND(10000)
40 PRINT"YOUR NUMBER IS :"HN
50 IF RND(2)=1THEN200
100 PRINT:PRINT"TYPE  'CALL' OR YOUR RAISE"
110 INPUT H$
120 IF H$<>"CALL"THEN 160
130 PRINT:PRINT:PRINT"MY NUMBER IS: "CN

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
